_idx.description: Index in the original array of objects posted.

account_id.description: Unique identifier of the account which owns the website.

website_id.description: Unique identifier of website to scan.

report_id.description: Unique identifier of the scan report (present on success).

error.description: Error code when a website cannot be scanned.

validation_errors.description: Validation error details (present when the error is a validation error).
